package.author: Vishwjeet Singh Vilkhu
package.description: Free, local-first speech AI & live interview practice platform
package.installationNotes: Launch WishPilot from your Start Menu. Use Ctrl+Shift+H to toggle the Stealth HUD and Ctrl+Shift+M for microphone. Add your free API key in Settings to start.

en-US.author: Vishwjeet Singh Vilkhu
en-US.description: Free, local-first speech AI & live interview practice platform
en-US.installationNotes: Launch WishPilot from your Start Menu. Use Ctrl+Shift+H to toggle the Stealth HUD and Ctrl+Shift+M for microphone. Add your free API key in Settings to start.
en-US.longDescription: WishPilot is an open-source, local-first speech intelligence engine and real-time interview simulation copilot with sub-second STT, unified AI providers, and native Windows screen-share shielding.
en-US.name: WishPilot
en-US.releaseNotes: Initial release of WishPilot v1.0.0 — featuring sub-second Groq Whisper STT, 9 streaming LLM providers, and native Windows stealth HUD.
